'''Iceglaze Base''', located on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], was the secondary base of operations for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Salmakk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its main purpose was the harvesting of [[lumni-spice]] due to its close proximity to a [[Dragon slug|dragon-slug]] warren. The lone safe path to the outpost was supposedly known only by Salmakk and his crew.
